Galician

[edit]

Noun

[edit]

vermelho m (plural vermelhos, reintegrationist norm)

  1. reintegrationist spelling of vermello

References

[edit]
  • “vermelho”, in Dicionário Estraviz de galego (in Galician), 2014–2026

Old Galician-Portuguese

[edit]

Alternative forms

[edit]
  • vermello

Etymology

[edit]

Inherited from Vulgar Latin *vermiclus, from Latin vermiculus (“little worm”).

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /βeɾ.ˈme.ʎo/

Adjective

[edit]

vermelho m (plural vermelhos, feminine vermelha, feminine plural vermelhas)

  1. red
    • 1198, Cancioneiro da Ajuda, Paio Soares de Taveirós, A 38: No mundo non me sei parella (facsimile)
      […] mia ſennoꝛ bꝛanca e / uermella.
      […] my lady of white skin and / reddish face.

Descendants

[edit]
  • Galician: vermello
  • Portuguese: vermelho (see there for further descendants)

Portuguese

[edit]
Portuguese Wikipedia has an article on:
vermelho
Wikipedia pt

Etymology 1

[edit]

Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese vermelho (“red”), from Vulgar Latin *vermiclus, from Latin vermiculus (“little worm”), from vermis (“worm”), ultimately in reference to a scale insect of species Kermes vermilio, used to make a crimson dye.

Cognate with Galician vermello, Spanish bermejo, Asturian bermeyu, Catalan vermell, Occitan vermelh, French vermeil and Italian vermiglio. Also related to English vermilion. Doublet of vermículo, which was borrowed.

Alternative forms

[edit]
  • vremeio, vermeio (pronunciation spelling, Caipira)

Pronunciation

[edit]
 
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /veʁˈme.ʎu/ [veɦˈme.ʎu]
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /veʁˈme.ʎu/ [veɦˈme.ʎu]
    • (São Paulo) IPA(key): /veɾˈme.ʎu/
    • (Rio de Janeiro) IPA(key): /veʁˈme.ʎu/
    • (Caipira) IPA(key): /veɻˈme.ʎu/
    • (Southern Brazil) IPA(key): /veʁˈme.ʎo/ [veɦˈme.ʎo]
 
  • (Portugal) IPA(key): /vɨɾˈmɐ(j).ʎu/
  • (Portugal) IPA(key): /vɨɾˈmɐ(j).ʎu/
    • (Northern Portugal) IPA(key): /bɨɾˈme.ʎu/
    • (Central Portugal) IPA(key): /vɨɾˈme.ʎu/
    • (Southern Portugal) IPA(key): /vɨɾˈme.ʎu/

  • (Caipira) IPA(key): /veɻ.ˈme.jo/
  • (Northeast Brazil) IPA(key): /veɦ.ˈme.ʎʊ/
  • Audio (Northern Portugal):(file)
  • Rhymes: -eʎu
  • Hyphenation: ver‧me‧lho

Adjective

[edit]

vermelho (feminine vermelha, masculine plural vermelhos, feminine plural vermelhas, diminutive vermelhinho)

  1. red (having red as its color)
  2. red (socialist or communist)

Noun

[edit]

vermelho m (plural vermelhos)

  1. red (color)
  2. red (socialist or communist)
  3. (sports) red card
